description: Have BrandStudio design a logo for a brand from a description — 'a logo for my joinery, plain, with a plane'. It makes several drafts; the first is set as the logo and REPLACES an existing one, and all drafts are returned. Uses the AI quota. Tell the user which draft is set; set another one with set_brand_logo. Brand ids come from list_brands.

description.description: What the logo should look like (3–2000 characters).

name: create_brand_logo
title: Design a logo (AI)
